label_leakage_control: Rule engine accepts only measurements file; labels are merged after predictions for evaluation.

split.method: 70/30 stratified by event-assignment group; patient-level split, all days for a patient remain in one split

rule_parameters.baseline: median of first 7 valid observations separately for weight and resting HR
rule_parameters.persistence: at least 2 threshold exceedances among the last 3 valid evaluated sessions for that signal
rule_parameters.impedance: Recorded and quality-checked, but not used for alerting because the hardware front-end is not verified
rule_parameters.normal_state: NO_RULE_TRIGGER means no configured rule fired; it is not a medical all-clear

development_metrics.interpretation: Synthetic-only estimates; not clinical accuracy. A no-alert output is not a declaration of medical normality.

held_out_test_metrics.interpretation: Synthetic-only estimates; not clinical accuracy. A no-alert output is not a declaration of medical normality.

limitations: All measurements and labels are synthetic and hand-specified; metrics measure agreement with the simulator's labels, not clinical accuracy.
No validated clinical thresholds are implied by +2% weight or +15% resting heart rate.
Foot-to-foot impedance is not used in alert decisions until the physical measurement circuit and safety are verified.
No real patient, sensor, BCG, ECG or hospital outcome validation is included.
A no-alert output cannot rule out deterioration; clinical review and local medical guidance remain necessary.
